svg.title: OLED — About Screen
svg.desc: RoboLore instructional graphic showing the bronze OLED module with the About screen content. The module image is embedded unchanged as a PNG via one xlink:href. All headers, labels, callouts, and on-screen text are editable SVG text.
svg.text: Change “YOUR NAME” to your actual name
• Button A opens the About screen.
• The top line is a centered title.
• The middle lines show project info.
• Replace the name line with your own name.
Press Button A on your Zumo to show this screen — the OLED uses setLayout21x8() (21 chars × 8 rows)
